title: Do LLM Agents Exhibit Social Behavior?

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring changes in resource allocation and prosocial actions during simulated behavioral economics games (e.g., dictator games) when the counterpart shares an induced ingroup identity (e.g., same hometown, university, or minimal group assignment) versus an outgroup identity.

Assigning diverse demographic personas (including age, gender, and academic major) to the LLM via system prompts and evaluating whether these attributes cause significant variability in their strategic and distributional decisions.
